create_simulation_gui: create an ARESimulationGui instance with a session ID, scenario ID, and agent config builder
import_scenario_from_json: import a simulation scenario from a JSON string and optionally replay its world logs
import_scenario_from_huggingface: import a simulation scenario from a HuggingFace dataset by dataset name, config, split, and scenario ID
export_simulation_trace: export the current simulation environment state and world logs to a JSON trace string
send_user_message_to_agent: send a user message with optional base64-encoded file attachments to the running simulation agent
